issues: Static validation 'ui primary flow' fails at step 46 (click button "Export" on the Settings screen) at both phone and desktop size, with page error 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' and empty visible text — i.e. the app crashes/blanks once the Settings tab is opened and the Export navigation is attempted. Fix the Settings area so the flow can continue: the likely culprit is src/navigation/index.tsx, where the Settings tab's `listeners={({navigation}) => ({ tabPress: e => navigation.navigate('Settings', { screen: 'SettingsMain' }) })}` re-dispatches a navigate to the same tab from within its own tabPress handler (recursive navigation), and the nested SettingsStack inside the tab. Remove/replace that tabPress re-navigation (e.g. use `navigation.navigate('Settings', { screen: 'SettingsMain' })` only after `e.preventDefault()`, or drop the listener entirely) and verify that tapping Settings renders SettingsScreen and that the 'Export' button (src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx) navigates to the Export screen, then that 'Export CSV'/'Export PDF' show 'Export ready to share', and that the rest of the flow (Backup & restore, Create encrypted backup, Restore, Delete all data) completes.

src/screens/ExportScreen.tsx does not actually export anything: `exportCsv` and `exportPdf` only call `showSuccess('Export ready to share')` with comments "In production, you would call generateCsv here" / "generatePdf here". The required feature (5) is tax-ready CSV and PDF generated on the device and shared through the share sheet. Wire these buttons to src/lib/exportCsv.ts / src/lib/exportPdf.ts and expo-sharing (write the file, then share), keeping the loading state and the success/failure messages.

src/lib/storage/device.web.ts returns `createMemoryRawStore()` and a key provider that generates a fresh random key on every call (`randomBytes(32)` inside `getKey()`), so on web nothing persists and each read uses a different key. Since the pipeline's UI checks run the web build, any data written and read across reloads (and possibly within a session, because a new key is produced per getKey call) will fail to decrypt. Make the web key provider derive/persist one key per session consistently and use a persistent raw store, or otherwise ensure the web build's store is coherent for the whole session.

Dashboard 'Estimated tax' is hard-coded to "$0.00" in src/screens/DashboardScreen.tsx (`<SummaryCard label="Estimated tax" value="$0.00" />`), so the configurable, never-negative estimated tax required by feature (4) is never shown. Compute it from income, expenses, mileage deduction and the stored tax rate (clamped at >= 0) and render that value.
feedback:
The blocking 'ui primary flow' check fails, so this cannot be approved yet. I reproduced the app bundle rendering fine under react-test-renderer (tab labels Dashboard/Receipts/Mileage/Settings and the Add receipt/Add mileage buttons are present), which narrows the failure to the Settings area: the flow's previous steps ('click tab "Settings"', 'screen settings') pass but then the page goes blank with 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' and the 'Export' button never becomes clickable. The Settings tab's tabPress listener in src/navigation/index.tsx re-dispatches navigation to the same tab without preventDefault, which is the most plausible recursion source — please fix and re-run the flow end to end (the remaining milestone-4 steps after Export have never been exercised).

Beyond the blocking failure, two feature gaps need real implementations rather than placeholders: ExportScreen only fakes CSV/PDF export (it shows the success message without generating or sharing a file), and the Dashboard's 'Estimated tax' card is a literal "$0.00". The web storage layer also uses a per-call random key over an in-memory raw store, which makes the encrypted store incoherent on the platform the UI checks exercise; that is likely to keep biting the flow checks even after the navigation fix.
